# Marvel Legends Chronicle

The complete chronological archive of every Marvel Legends action figure, 2002–2026.
Fan-made. Not affiliated with Marvel, Hasbro, or Toy Biz.

## What this is

- Timeline of 1,904 figures across 158 waves, Toy Biz (2002–2006) through Hasbro (2007–2026)
- Collector encyclopedia: line history, packaging evolution, variant/chase/exclusive taxonomy, 23-entry hall of fame (with reissue-radar flags), grading guide, transparent price methodology, bootleg-spotting guide, resources
- BAF planner: mark owned figures, see missing Build-A-Figure pieces + acquisition guidance (browser-local)
- 46 character pages (`characters/<slug>.html`): every release of the most-collected characters, chronological
- Bootleg authentication wizard: step-by-step pass/fail flow with verdict
- Price guide page: the sold-listings method, aggregator limits, dated price history, reissue effect
- Fan community (client-side demo): profiles, feed, likes, comments, follows, figure-tagged posts
- Collection tracker: mark figures Owned / Wanted (browser-local)

## API (static JSON, versioned)

Base: `api/v1/`

- `api/v1/index.json` — manifest: version, endpoints, observation date, provenance
- `api/v1/stats.json` — totals, per-year and per-manufacturer counts, BAF/exclusive/variant tallies
- `api/v1/waves.json` — 158 wave summaries (id, year, manufacturer, series, baf, figureCount)
- `api/v1/figures.json` — flat list of all 1,904 figures with wave context
- `api/v1/encyclopedia.json` — history timeline, packaging evolution, variant/chase/exclusive taxonomy, hall of fame (with reissue radar), grading guide, transparent price methodology, bootleg guide, resources directory
- `api/v1/schema/wave.json`, `api/v1/schema/figure.json` — JSON Schema (draft-07)

## Skills (agentic task procedures)

212 skills in `skills/` — rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_skills.py`
(generates from `data/*.json` + authored procedures; outputs committed).
`skills/index.json` is the manifest: id, title, description, path per skill.

For agents: load the skill whose task matches the request — skills are the
primary interface for *doing* work; the JSON endpoints are the data layer.
`api/v1/index.json` points here (`repository`, `skills`, `for_agents`).

Categories: baf (101 completion checklists), characters (46 collector guides),
grails (24 dossiers), bootleg (8), eras (5), collection (5), marketplace (4),
community (4), variants (4), hunts (11).

## Stable ids

Figure ids are `<waveId>::<figureName>`, e.g. `toybiz-2002-series-1::Hulk`.
Wave ids are kebab-case slugs. Ids are stable; new figures get new ids, never recycled.
Unknown or disputed values are explicit `null` with a `notes` field — never invented.

## Known limitations

- Within-year ordering is year-accurate but not audited to the month.
- Some BAF pieces and disputed wave numbers are flagged unverified in notes.
- Hall-of-fame prices are secondary-market observations; entries from single or
  tabloid sources carry `verified: false`.
- Encyclopedia claims added 2026-10-11 carry `source` + `confidence`
  (`verified` / `single-source` / `anecdote` / `unverified` / `analysis`).
- Marketplace links on the site are pre-filled search links (mock integration),
  not live inventory.

## Regenerating the API

`python3 scripts/build_api.py` rebuilds `api/v1/` from `data/figures.json`
and `data/encyclopedia.json`. Commit the outputs.

## Site structure

- `index.html` — chronological timeline with search, filters, year rail, tracker
- `encyclopedia.html` — history, packaging evolution, variants/chases/exclusives, hall of fame, grading guide, bootleg guide, resources
- `baf-planner.html` — "complete my BAF" planner (browser-local, syncs with tracker)
- `characters/index.html` + `characters/<slug>.html` — 46 generated character archive pages (rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_characters.py`); `characters/manifest.json` lists slug, name, count, first/last year per character
- `price-guide.html` — transparent sold-listings methodology, dated price history, reissue effect
- `auth-wizard.html` — interactive bootleg authentication wizard
- `community.html` — fan social (localStorage demo)
- `api.html` — human-readable API docs
- `assets/css/` — tokens, base, layout, components, timeline, encyclopedia, community
- `assets/js/` — config, store, data, tracker, listings, modal, figure-dialog,
  timeline, encyclopedia, baf-planner, price-guide, auth-wizard, community, community-page (ES modules)
